title: Semantic Service Test Obligation Manifest
description: Machine-readable obligation manifest for USF-239. It maps every semantic contract, Compose service catalogue row, generated test Compose service, profile, owner issue, validation command, fixture/evidence boundary, and non-claim to required test-readiness obligations. It is an obligation gate only and does not claim final test readiness or external readiness.
aiGuidance: Any future AI-delivered service, capability, Compose, fixture, coverage, proof, or evidence change must update the semantic definition, test obligation manifest, fixture mapping, coverage expectation, evidence row, validator coverage, and non-claims in the same PR or fail validation.
authorityBoundary: This manifest derives executable test obligations from semantic contracts, the Compose service catalogue, the generated test Compose target, and prior USF-235 through USF-238 evidence. Linear tracks work only and does not define test semantics.

coveragePolicy.unsupportedCoverageBoundary: USF-240 defines exact in-scope files and justified exclusions in docs/architecture/test-coverage-gate.json. The bounded gate does not satisfy repository-wide coverage, final USF-234 acceptance, or environment promotion readiness.

obligationClasses.purpose: Pure implementation and validator unit tests for semantic obligations
Composed service integration tests for service-backed obligations
Executable enterprise and ISO-style evidence tests without certification claims
Functional regression tests generated from semantic definitions
Failure-mode, degraded readiness, retry, recovery, audit, and observability tests
Semantic, API, provider, command, and Compose drift tests
Planted defects and missing-evidence regression gate
Synthetic seed, reset, cleanup, teardown, and deterministic fixture obligations
Authentication, authorization, tenant, role, and permission exhaustive coverage
Data lifecycle, retention, privacy, search, analytics, object storage, and secrets tests
Backup, restore, bulk upload, import, export, and migration tests
Every generated test Compose service and profile exercise gate
Future AI work semantic test update guardrail
Required catalogue-only or deferred service must have explicit bounded disposition
Historical or out-of-scope service retained only as non-test disposition
Repo-enforce hostile input, malformed payload, tenant-boundary, provider-boundary, and fail-closed abuse testing obligations before final test-readiness acceptance.
Repo-enforce deterministic local performance, concurrency, bounded load, resource cleanup, and profile startup budget obligations before final test-readiness acceptance.
Repo-enforce dependency, lockfile, exact version, SBOM, licence, advisory, SDK governance, and image pinning obligations before final test-readiness acceptance.
Repo-enforce mutation and fault-injection adequacy obligations that prove representative semantic, evidence, fixture, command, and non-claim weakening is caught.
Repo-enforce adversarial semantic, cross-model consistency, authority-boundary, ambiguity, contradiction, and future-AI drift obligations before final test-readiness acceptance.
Repo-enforce environment, tooling, version-control, generated-artifact, local/CI parity, clean checkout, and private-state hygiene obligations before final test-readiness acceptance.
